places.w: Hilltop teriyaki counter with teriyaki plates and combos, yakisoba, chow mein and a katsu burrito. Closed Saturdays.
Teriyaki counter on S Steele St whose menu also has Chinese dishes, sushi and boba.
Sixth Avenue teriyaki shop; plates come with two scoops of rice and salad. Also serves bento boxes, sushi rolls and Chinese dishes.
Parkland-area teriyaki and wok counter on Pacific Ave S, with pineapple teriyaki, prawn skewers and bento specials.
East Side Tacoma shop pairing a teriyaki plate menu with pho.
Downtown Tacoma teriyaki-and-sushi counter, part of the Happy Teriyaki group with locations in Fife and Lacey.

South Hill teriyaki shop serving chicken and beef teriyaki plates and grilled vegetables.
Teriyaki shop on Military Rd; plates come with rice and a small salad.
Teriyaki counter on S 312th St with teriyaki plates and gyoza or katsu combos.
